# Inventory Management App - React Native Project

This is a React Native mobile application for inventory management with the following features:
- Camera integration for taking photos of inventory items
- File upload system for manuals, documents, and training materials
- Advanced search functionality
- Offline storage capabilities
- Item categorization and tagging system

## Project Structure
- Uses React Native CLI
- Navigation with React Navigation
- State management with Redux Toolkit
- Local database with SQLite
- File storage management
- Camera and media handling

## Development Guidelines
- Follow React Native best practices
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Implement proper error handling
- Ensure offline functionality
- Optimize for both iOS and Android platforms
